append.detail:
The responsive inspector model reads the existing block contract's fields and surface field list. Tablet and phone overrides inherit desktop per field and report the source of each value. Reset clears one device field and preserves the other device and remaining overrides. Focused tests cover surface limits, false and zero values, provenance, and reset. Live inspector integration, container queries, and touch verification on real viewports remain open.

UPDATE 2026-11-14 (live integration, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS; split out and closed as PROG-E5A): /pages/canvas (staff only, a 404 when the switch is off) now mounts components/builder/inspector/responsive-inspector.tsx beside the canvas frame. The route derives the Banner contract's space-site fields on the server (lib/builder/inspector-fields.ts inspectorFieldViews, over inspectorFields), so the registry never ships to the client; text, url, textarea, toggle and every enum primitive draw as controls, and rich fields (lists, images, cards, pickers) are counted and left to their own editors. The inspector shares the frame's device switcher (Desktop, Tablet, Phone), writes per device with setInspectorValue, labels every field with its provenance (Set on desktop, Set for phone, Inherited from desktop, Not set yet), and shows a per-field Reset to desktop only where a tablet or phone override exists. Below lg it opens in the existing bottom sheet from a full-width button with a Done action; at lg it sits in a side column. The form reflows by its own width with a Tailwind container query (@container, @md:grid-cols-2). No hover-only UI; every control, reset and device button is min-h-11 (44px). The frame draws the resolved headline for the chosen device. Probe scripts/probes/builder/PROG-E5A.mjs.

Still open on this row: values are local to the page and not persisted (BlockNode has no breakpoint axis yet, see the E0 note in docs/EDITOR-ARCHITECTURE.md, and that needs a storage change); the inspector is not yet inside the website builder shell or the Space page builder; one demo block (Banner) is wired, not the selected block of a real document; and the E5 gate itself, every control reachable by touch on real phone and tablet viewports, stays a manual browser check.
